authoredTests.maxSizeCases: 2 cases with n=10^6 (digit values; all zeros), each about 2 MB; plus near-max n=999997..999999 zero cases and n up to 131072 with values near 2*10^9
authoredTests.motivation: Targets wrong algorithms found in the selected WA sources (inspected only, never executed): k loop stops at n-1 (6473617), prefix table f[0] overwritten by f[-1]=n (6544288), q_i summed with + instead of xor (10255184), X[r-1]/X[i-1] wrapping to X[-1] (29555463); also the upstream text typo Q up to q_{n-1}. Re-implemented mutants in test_recipe_424C.py are each killed by at least 5 authored tests (132/56/99/37/134).

constraints.lineLayout: line 1: n alone; line 2: exactly n space-separated integers; LF or CRLF; no extra/blank lines; tokens must match 0|[1-9][0-9]* (rejects +, _, leading zeros, signs)

officialReview.notes: All 6 official pairs (CRLF, preserved) and the sample parse within constraints and match both the efficient oracle and the literal brute. The 23 open-r1 generated tests are not in the supplied input and were not reviewed; parent should validate them with parse() before use.

oracle.bruteDomains: all p in {0..3}^n for n=1..6 (5460); zero and random full-range arrays for n=1..150 (300); 100 random arrays n=151..400
oracle.efficient: answer(): xor of p, plus for each k in 1..n: prefix_xor(k-1) if n//k odd, and prefix_xor(n mod k); prefix_xor closed form by x mod 4. O(n).
oracle.independentBrute: literal(): definition double loop over i and k, O(n^2).

selectedSourceInspection.okInspected: 6464542 read in full (same per-k parity formula as the oracle); other OK sources not individually reviewed.
selectedSourceInspection.tleOnlyNote: Recorded TLE; most are the literal O(n^2) definition (6479353 uses i mod k = i for k>i, still correct). 52525059/77092488 count residue multiplicities; 14798443 was not analyzed for correctness. None is claimed as an algorithmic kill.

semantics: Line 1: n, 1<=n<=10^6. Line 2: exactly n integers 0<=p_i<=2*10^9 (exponents attested from the public English statement). Unique integer Q = q_1 xor ... xor q_n with q_i = p_i xor (i mod 1) xor ... xor (i mod n); the formula image and the sample fix the last term as q_n, not the upstream text q_{n-1}. Oracle: Q = xor(p) xor, for each modulus k, (prefix xor 0..k-1 when n//k is odd) xor (prefix xor 0..n mod k). Independently checked by the literal n^2 double loop over all (i, k) on exhaustive small domains and fixed-seed random arrays.
